Master Ability / 聖石に導かれし鋭気

Other allies gain a permanent Slash ATK increase at the start of their own turns, stacking up to 5 times. The effect lasts while Logi remains alive; another copy cannot activate while the first user survives.

自身以外の味方全員を「自身の行動開始時に永続で斬撃攻撃力アップ（5回まで重複可）」の状態にする（発動者が死亡するまで効果が持続&先に発動したユニットが死亡するまで同一効果の発動不可）

The Endless Journey of Brothers

Select artwork to enlarge

兄弟の終わりなき歩み

Story summary

This memento follows the emotional weight of Logi and Dios’s diverging paths. Watching his brother’s back grow distant forces Logi to confront his own powerlessness. Fading pleas to stay together recall their childhood bonds and Agatha’s wishes, while the brothers stand with the cleaved blue flames behind them and accept their coming conflict.

Passion Galloping on the Battlefield

Select artwork to enlarge

戦場を駆ける激情

Translated story excerpt

Beliefs differ, and justice differs. At the end of it all, swords will be crossed. No mercy for knights who accept the sacrifice of the people. “Is that… the word of a knight who feigns justice?!” Like the decorations I wear on my body, I will make a peaceful everyday life a reality, where people with dazzling brilliance can live normally. I cannot overlook those who defile this beloved world.

Unit Enlightenment

SEVEN GATES

Unlock at level 85 and 25 limit breaks. Later gates require level 2 in the preceding gate.

Profile and Artworks

A resolve to protect, together.

Leader of the Azure Guard, a volunteer army. Facing his envy of others, Logi recognizes the strength of companions who possess what he lacks. He resolves to protect the world he loves alongside them, even if that means wielding tremendous power.

Original Japanese profile
義勇軍である蒼の団の団長。他者への羨望という『嫉妬』と向き合い、自分にはない良さを持つ仲間が必要と改めて実感する。愛しき世界はひとりで守るのではなく、ともに歩む仲間と強大な力を行使してでも守るという覚悟を持つ。
